name: Duke Erisia's Laboratory
desc:
Duke Erisia's Laboratory consists of a small interlude hall where you fight Golem Primes and Mindless Servants, and the arena where the player fights [Duke Ishamon Erisia](entity:duke_ishamon_erisia). You can enter this area by going through [Duke Erisia's Manor](location:duke_erisias_manor) and descending down through the elevator.

When entering the arena section, you will see the Duke himself and several tubes with Mindless Servants in them.
additional_info:
-   The first room is obligated to do, you must kill many Mindless Servants and two Prime Golems to advance to the other rooms
-   You can skip all rooms except the first to go directly to the Duke Erisia
